title: Patching lemma: locally integer multiplicity currents are integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open and X ∈ D_k(U). Suppose every x ∈ U has an open set V with x ∈ V ⊆ U and an integer multiplicity current Y ∈ D_k(U) such that X(ω) = Y(ω) for every ω ∈ D^k(U) with tsupport ω ⊆ V. Then X is an integer multiplicity current.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ V : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen V ∧ x ∈ V ∧ V ⊆ U ∧ ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → X ω = Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X
